name: User Workflow
query:
SELECT
    hr.parent        AS "User:Link/User:220",
    u.full_name      AS "Full Name::180",
    w.document_type  AS "DocType:Link/DocType:180",
    w.name           AS "Workflow:Link/Workflow:180",
    r.role           AS "Role:Link/Role:150",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.source ORDER BY r.source SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Role Used In::160"
FROM (
    SELECT parent AS workflow, allowed AS role, 'Transition' AS source
    FROM `tabWorkflow Transition`
    UNION ALL
    SELECT parent AS workflow, allow_edit AS role, 'State (Edit)' AS source
    FROM `tabWorkflow Document State`
) r
INNER JOIN `tabWorkflow` w ON w.name = r.workflow AND w.is_active = 1
INNER JOIN `tabHas Role` hr ON hr.role = r.role AND hr.parenttype = 'User'
INNER JOIN `tabUser` u ON u.name = hr.parent AND u.enabled = 1
WHERE
    (%(user)s IS NULL OR %(user)s = '' OR hr.parent = %(user)s)
    AND (%(document_type)s IS NULL OR %(document_type)s = '' OR w.document_type = %(document_type)s)
GROUP BY hr.parent, u.full_name, w.document_type, w.name, r.role
ORDER BY hr.parent, w.document_type
